title: Buzcuk Optimization Pack
description: This Mod pack will optimize your mc i3 5005U with Mellow shader can run stable minecraft with this pack
body:
🛠 v1.0.0 - Optimization Update

    Supported Versions: Minecraft 1.20.1 & 1.21+

🚀 Performance & Engine

    Sodium: The core rendering engine replacement that significantly boosts FPS on low-end hardware (like Intel HD graphics).

    Lithium: Optimizes game physics, chunk loading, and AI logic to reduce the heavy load on your CPU.

    ImmediatelyFast: Speeds up the rendering of menus, HUDs, and text to eliminate UI-related lag.

    EntityCulling: Skips rendering for mobs and entities you cannot see, providing a massive FPS jump in crowded areas or farms.

💡 Visuals & Lighting

    ScalableLux: A modern, high-performance lighting engine that optimizes world lighting updates without the FPS hit of traditional engines.

    Iris: Allows for hardware-optimized shader support, specifically chosen for its superior performance over older shader engines.

    Indium: An essential compatibility bridge that allows Sodium to render complex block models and custom visual effects seamlessly.

🌐 Networking & Connection

    Krypton: Optimizes the network stack to reduce CPU usage and eliminate "ghost blocks" during multiplayer sessions.

    Placeholder API: A lightweight utility used by various mods to display dynamic information without taxing the system.

⚡ [Beta]26.1.2 - Next-Gen Performance Update

(Optimized for 4GB RAM & Low-End Duos)
🚀 Core Performance

    Sodium & Lithium: The ultimate duo, fine-tuned to minimize CPU usage and significantly lift your FPS ceiling.

    ImmediatelyFast: Ensures instantaneous menu navigation and text rendering without straining your GPU.

    EntityCulling: Disables rendering for creatures behind walls or outside your field of view, eliminating lag in crowded areas.

    BadOptimizations: Eliminates micro-stutters by stopping unnecessary background rendering processes using smart "trick" methods.

🧠 Memory & System Optimization

    ModernFix (mVUS Profile): Drastically minimizes RAM usage and speeds up game startup times.

    Language Reload: Saves precious memory by processing language files only when needed, rather than storing them permanently in RAM.

    Dynamic FPS: Automatically reduces resource usage when the game is minimized (Alt-Tab), giving your processor a well-deserved rest.

    Sodium Extra: Unlocks advanced performance settings within Sodium, allowing you to optimize your system down to the finest detail.

🌐 Multiplayer & Network Tuning

    Very Many Players (VMP): Optimizes heavy server traffic and reduces processor load when playing on crowded multiplayer servers.

    Packet Fixer: Resolves network-related freezing and crashes, specifically optimized for systems running on 4GB of RAM.

    No Chat Reports: Disables background cryptographic signature checks, lowering network latency (ping) and improving privacy.

🌅 Visuals & Atmosphere

    ScalableLux: Next-generation lighting engine that illuminates your world fluidly without causing frame drops.

    FogFree: Removes suffocating fog and pitch darkness, making the game look much brighter, spacious, and visually clear.

📦 The Core Essentials (Included in All Versions)

To ensure maximum stability and ease of use, every version of this optimization pack includes these foundational mods:

    Fabric API: The essential core library required for almost every Fabric mod to function.

    Mod Menu: An intuitive in-game interface to view, search, and configure all your installed mods.

    Cloth Config API: An auxiliary configuration library used to power the settings screens of major performance mods like Sodium Extra.

    📌 Compatibility Note: FerriteCore is currently not included in the latest release profile due to version compatibility limits. To maintain peak RAM optimization on 4GB setups, we are strictly utilizing a highly customized ModernFix-mVUS configuration, fully compliant with Modrinth distribution rules.
